countries.reasoning: Based on USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries and Chinese national geological survey data for iron oxide pigment production, China is the dominant global producer with very reliable recent statistics.
India is a key producer of iron oxides used in pigments, supported by government mining and manufacturing reports, although reporting can have slight delays.
USGS and industry association data indicate the US as a significant producer with stable output in recent years.
Germany maintains strong production capacities especially in synthetic iron oxide pigments; data from European chemical industry sources are fairly reliable but somewhat less detailed.
Brazil produces natural iron oxide pigments with moderate data quality from national mining statistical reports; figures are approximate but consistent with export data.
